scope: Execute the built loader's NTFS read code against modeled disk I/O and extent lookup.
tests: Complete read spanning two separately located DATA extents
Unaligned request crosses the extent boundary without losing or repeating bytes
Seek into later extent and clamp request at logical EOF
EOF and zero-byte reads do not access disk
Missing later extent reports I/O failure with the actual partial count
Short underlying disk transfer is rejected
limitation: Extent lookup is modeled; real ATTRIBUTE_LIST lookup is separately exercised by the unchanged fragmented SYSTEM hive in xemu run 051.
